Treatment summary
The patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of
right shoulder pain and restricted range of motion. The reported mechanism of injury
is consistent with the nature and force of the collision. Imaging and physical
examination findings clearly confirm the shoulder injury, and the patient has no known
prior injury to this body region. Care was delivered over nineteen visits and followed
a typical course of conservative management, including manual therapy, graded
therapeutic exercise, and home exercise instruction. Pain and functional limitations
improved steadily, and visit frequency tapered as the patient progressed toward
discharge. Billing records reflect single charges for each service rendered, with no
duplicated or repeated billing observed. At discharge, the patient demonstrated
near-normal shoulder mobility and strength, with residual symptoms that were mild and
activity-limited. Continued home exercise was recommended, with follow-up as needed
for any recurrence of symptoms.
